packet_selection_diagnostic.notes: Media-timestamp decomposition, not wall-clock callback duration. The first encoded packet passing the commit CTS floor may represent a later presentation frame when B-frames reorder packet output. Its CTS gap must not be attributed entirely to command handling or graphics scheduling.

limitations: Decoded candidate is a selected picture; marker boundary certifies only the first changed probe marker, neither certifies display.
DirectShow duplicate/gap counters concern the return consumer, not encoder dropped frames.
No single-lane or external network campaign; resource comparison not inferred.
